sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Crazy Gravity is a puzzle platformer that challenges players to navigate through increasingly difficult levels while avoiding obstacles and enemies. The game's unique twist is its use of gravity, which can be manipulated in various ways to solve puzzles and reach new heights. Players can use gravity to pull themselves towards or away from objects, or even create temporary platforms to get across gaps.

As players progress through the game, the challenges become increasingly difficult, with new obstacles and enemies introduced at each level. Players will need to use their wits and quick reflexes to navigate through tight spaces, avoid deadly traps, and defeat enemies in order to reach the next level. With its addictive gameplay and increasingly difficult challenges, Crazy Gravity is a game that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish.

One of the standout features of Crazy Gravity is its use of gravity to create complex puzzles. Players will need to think creatively and use gravity to solve problems and reach new areas. Whether it's creating a temporary platform to get across a gap or using gravity to pull themselves up to a high platform, the game's use of gravity is a key part of its challenge and addictiveness.

The game also features a variety of power-ups and upgrades that players can collect to give them an edge in their journey. From speed boosts to shields, these power-ups can make a big difference in the game's more challenging levels. Players will also need to collect coins and other rewards to unlock new levels and content, adding a sense of progression and achievement to the game.
